key_insight: For structure-encoded tasks, more examples may narrow but need not eliminate the finite-resource gap between example-only learning and methods given the governing structure.
engineering_relevance: When validated operators, physical laws, graphs, or constraints are available, encode them before training and reserve learning for unspecified components.
method: Define the structure gap in finite-data identification, extrapolation, and certification.
Prove Gaussian inverse-problem excess risk, a cell-coverage lower bound, and unobserved-orbit non-identifiability.
Test the mechanisms in known-operator inversion, sparse recovery, and graph reachability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports exact Gaussian risk results and controlled experiments, including graph-size extrapolation, but provides no numerical effect sizes.
watch_item: The advantage depends on validated governing structure; the results do not establish universal superiority over data-driven learning.
paper_title: The Structure Gap: When More Data Cannot Replace Structured Reasoning
